title: SEC6: PinnedCertVerifier avoids disabling TLS
description: new_with_root_cert installs a custom ServerCertVerifier that accepts exactly one pinned DER byte string. The verifier still delegates verify_tls12_signature and verify_tls13_signature to the platform CryptoProvider, so the full TLS handshake and signature path runs in tests. The alternative — passing danger().accept_invalid_certs() or equivalent — would skip signature verification entirely, meaning tests would not exercise any of the TLS correctness code. The pin-by-DER approach also fails fast and clearly if the wrong certificate is presented (returns UnknownIssuer), rather than silently accepting anything.
